Subject: Alliance handoff: BlueBridge consulting enablement & SI checklist

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Per our discussion, I attached a lightweight "Gateway SI playbook" and a technical onboarding checklist to frame the first 30/60/90 days for BlueBridge consultants. Core asks for this first phase: 

- Confirm 2 trainers and 4 consultants for the initial enablement cohort (names + emails).
- Provide a target kickoff window (we suggested week of 6/26).
- Confirm whether BlueBridge wants Redwood-managed sandbox accounts or SSO-only access.

Attachments: Gateway-SI-playbook-v0.3.pdf (playbook draft), technical-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (checklist).

Suggested agenda for kickoff call (45m): intros + enablement goals (10m), sandbox access walk-through (15m), sales/solution play overview (10m), action items & next steps (10m).

I copied Rishi and Camila so we can split technical vs GTM items. If this looks good, can you confirm the attendee list and the kickoff date by EOD Thursday (6/16)?

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances

Laura —

Really helpful packet, thanks. BlueBridge is aligned and excited to proceed. Quick answers:

- Trainers/consultants: I can confirm two trainers (Monica Reyes, marcus@bluebridge.com) and four consultants (list attached in a follow up).
- Kickoff: week of 6/26 works; prefer Tue 6/27 10:00am PT if that fits Redwood's calendar.
- Sandbox access: we prefer Redwood-managed sandbox accounts for the first POC cohort; we'll move to SSO post-PoC.

A couple of asks on our side before kickoff:
1) Can you share a short engineer-facing runbook for KV cache/latency expectations so our infra lead can review?
2) How does the SI certification path work (time to certify, sample quiz, requirements)?

I'll loop partner-ops to coordinate attendee names and any paperwork.

Thanks — Sarah
